sn35.55:1.1: Kathaṃ nu kho bhante jānato katham passato saṃyojanā samugghātam gacchantīti || || Cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu anattato jānato passato samyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || || Rūpe anattato || || Cakkhuviññāṇam anattato || || Cakkhusamphassam anattato || || pe || || Yam pidam manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkham asukhaṃ vā || tam pi anattato jānato passato samyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti || || Evaṃ kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato saṃyojanā samugghātam gacchantīti || ||
